name: origin-ui-timeline
title: Timeline
description: A vertical list of five numbered stages, each with a small date, a bold title, a description and a hollow circle on a connecting line. Steps up to the active one brighten, and clicking a title moves the marker.
use: You need a fixed sequence of stages with dates and a clear sense of how far along it is.
avoid: Only a handful of stages read well, and the click targets are plain titles with no button styling.
a11y: Step titles are clickable headings with no button role or tab stop, so keyboard and screen reader users cannot change the active stage. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow column on a black stage holds a small uppercase label, a bold heading and five stacked entries. Each entry has a faint date, a title, a two-line grey description, and a small ring on a thin vertical line at the left; the first entries look brighter than the last two.
behaves: Clicking a step title makes it the active stage, so that entry and all above it turn bright while the rest stay dim. The recording shifts the active step a few times and the rail fills up to the chosen point; nothing scrolls or folds.
customise: Pass steps as item children and drive the active stage with value or defaultValue; headings, dates and copy are yours, while colours and rail sizing are classes in the file.
weight: light: A dozen styled divs and a few colour transitions; no animation loop.
